vulnerability.name: USN-7812-1
vulnerability.description: Woojin Park, Hojun Lee, Yougin Won and Siyeon Han discovered that ImageMagick did not properly sanitize image file names. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service, obtain sensitive information, or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-55298)  Lumina Mescuwa discovered that ImageMagick did not properly handle memory when encoding BMP images. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause ImageMagick to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-57803)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in ImageMagick. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
